repos/open-hax/proxx/pulls/445.body:
The Kimi workflow previously used a stale model route and combined inference with publication. It now uses the catalog-supported `kimi-code-plan-global/kimi-for-coding` route with advertised `low` control, keeps inference read-only, and publishes through a fresh job using the installed OpenCode App. Publication verifies immutable base-ancestral helper bytes, exact head/base/run/attempt provenance and complete diff/file coverage before token exchange; native owner/body readback and final token revocation remain required.

The branch incorporates qualified PR #451 through ordinary merge `d05879c944ca0c9a73f7b738ee61667e21ee8a82`, preserving both complete receipt histories. Its selected helper `2810f4515424a146fe37390fb0baf532cca31236` retains exactly the merged helper bytes. The existing issue-comment handler recognizes live writer commands without responding recursively to Bot output. The evidence caller consumes qualified Eta #341 reviewed revision `45ec644c2d15ed511e9bc1e797d1b4073b63dbfc`, with Muse and global skills still pinned.

Validation: the combined local runner/auth/canary suite ran 105 cases; 104 passed and one obsolete pre-merge prose assertion failed. After correcting that assertion, the affected 71-case runner suite passed without skips; the 34 unaffected auth/canary cases had already passed. The final workflow retains all three upstream suites. Focused Node 22 caller-interface validation, standard actionlint on the three changed review workflows, and diff hygiene pass. Local fixtures do not establish actual App/model execution.

Fresh exact-head hosted qualification is pending: native App diagnostic/readback/revocation, full low-route Kimi review, enrolled reviewer identity, deterministic gates and independent reviews. A COMMENTED diagnostic or generic GitHub Actions result grants no approval or round credit. Hidden provider model and actual reasoning budget remain unknown. No paid/on-demand credits, protection changes, production deployment or historical receipt edits are included.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Automated reviews run on the exact pull request revision, only for non-draft pull requests from the same repository, and only after regression tests pass.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * OpenCode comment commands trigger only when `/oc` or `/opencode` appears at the start of a comment, followed by whitespace or the end of the comment. Comments from bots no longer trigger runs.

  * Expanded coverage for review validation, publication safeguards, and command handling.
